sein.name: 세인
sein.design: SEIN, a female DEER-themed letter archivist. Preserve the screenshot's VERY LONG dark cool charcoal/navy-gray wavy hair, thick soft swept bangs and paired broad S-curled lengths falling almost to the shoes on both sides. It is long flowing hair, not short or braided. Muted cool violet-gray shadow/end panels, no smooth ombre. Large thin round dark glasses with a subtle muted-rose edge, BOTH lenses clear so the matching gray-lavender irises and tiny catchlights remain visible. The round black clock/rose fascinator with simple silver outlines sits on viewer RIGHT of the head. Adapt the two tall white head shapes to a pair of slender IVORY DEER ANTLERS, with only one small branch each; keep the tall white silhouette, no rabbit ears. Small deer ears tucked into the hair and one little deer tail. Black short high-collar dress/coat with a simple pale center placket, thin silver edging and waist belt, a broad black cape opened at the front, a white inner hem, white/pale little knee boots with dark soles. Do not add the old purple waistcoat. Calm kind reserved smile, one open empty hand near the chest and the other lightly touching the coat edge. No book, staff or floating decorative leaf effect.

daon.name: 다온
daon.design: DAON, an androgynous male MOTH-themed observatory attendant. Preserve the screenshot's short SILVER-WHITE fluffy hair with thick curved side-swept bangs, pale cool lavender-blue shadow panels, matching muted olive-gold irises. A round black clock/rose fascinator with simple silver details on viewer RIGHT. Adapt the pair of long white head shapes to two long fine white FUZZY MOTH ANTENNAE rising upward and gently curving, not solid rabbit ears. TWO softly rounded ivory/light-gray moth wings attached behind the shoulders, kept compact behind the cape and distinct from the arms. Costume: white high-collar shirt with one broad vertical white front panel, black/dark navy short tailored outer jacket with LONG dark navy split cape/tailcoat panels falling behind toward the ankles, narrow pale trim, ONE little gold star brooch at upper chest, black short trousers with both legs clearly separate, white little boots with dark soles. Keep a tiny boyish body and short legs. Polite quiet smile, relaxed empty hands, one slightly raised greeting hand. No notebook, telescope, oversized gown or added props. LATEST USER OVERRIDE: the black clock/rose headpiece is a THIN FLAT fascinator like Sein's, close against the hair, never a cylindrical top hat or tall hat crown.

lumi.name: 루미
lumi.design: 짙은 차콜 검정 웨이브 머리·가운데 흰 앞머리 한 가닥·길게 흘러내리는 낮은 양갈래, 회색 눈·분홍 볼. 흰 칼라와 작은 흰/은색 목 부분의 검정 짧은 원피스, 얇은 회청색 치맛단, 검정 무릎 양말·구두. 어두운 차콜색 둥근 크로스백·짙은 차콜 사선 스트랩·짧게 매달린 차콜/은회색 장식. 머리 위에 둥근 귀·길쭉한 몸·짧은 다리·밝은 얼굴과 배를 가진 차콜/세이블 페럿 한 마리가 붙어 쉰다.

soyul.name: 소율
soyul.design: 밝은 애쉬 플래티넘 짧은 낮은 양갈래·일자 앞머리와 보랏빛 푸른 눈은 유지. 머리띠·목 리본·머리끈은 짙은 푸른색, 머리 리본·케이플릿·원피스·메리제인 구두는 어두운 남색. 작은 금장과 푸른 사파이어 장식, 흰 소매·양말·칼라·치맛단. 기존 작은 제비 날개와 갈라진 꼬리는 짙은 청흑색으로 유지.
